snippet.title: Scales of Silence - Announcement Trailer | 8-Player Couch Co-Op Snake Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489580/Scales_of_Silence/

The classic snake game has a story to tell.

Scales of Silence takes the game everyone played as a kid and turns it into something nobody expected. Collisions don't kill you - they shrink you. Your length is your health. Simple to learn. Brutal to master.

500-level story campaign across 10 biomes. 20 playable serpents, each with unique stats. Boss fights. An ancient war between two factions. A living darkness feeding on their conflict. A mystery hiding underneath it all.

Then there's the couch multiplayer. Up to 8 players on one screen. No split-screen. No online-only workaround. Four battle modes. Mix keyboards and gamepads however you want. Your house, your rules.

One purchase. Everything included. Zero microtransactions. Free content updates planned.

Coming September 7.

Website: https://scalesofsilence.com/
Studio: https://aggrogames.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/6RJJ2edS7j
